removed: - An unnamed `size` is admitted only in the root of the body of a body refusal (the row `body_limit` of `forms/refusals.tsv`: `413` with the kind `toolarge` and the body limit as `limit`): it is checked to be an integer JSON number equal to the known full entity-body size in bytes, not a string and not a boolean, and is then excluded from the comparison with `expect`. A valid, representable `Content-Length` defines that full size even for an early answer after only a prefix of the body has been sent. With `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, `Content-Length` is ignored: the full size of a completed chunked body is the sum of the decoded chunk-data bytes, excluding chunk framing and trailers; for an incomplete chunked body the full size is unknown and `size` is absent. A refusal for an unrepresentable framing length has no `size`. The absence of `size` remains admissible when the full size is known; other unnamed fields, `key` included, are not admitted (the column `free` above). A weight refusal names `key` and `size` in `expect`, and they are compared as named fields.\n

removed:
- **A batch in the group (ADR-0094 B9).** A door forwards a batch whole: the followers read both rows with one version; a replay by `id` goes through a voter and through a door; a stale `cas` of a row means the others are not written. The door's own row by a batch — 403 (N1.3 `door`). After `@sigkill` of the leader the new leader gives both rows (judge-only: sc. 31; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.1-R135).
- **Size and the door without a vote.** A join beyond the declared size — 409 `refused` both without `force` and with `force` (`-force` does not take beyond the declared size; N1.3 `join`). A door (`-door -voters`): `state` `Door`, a write through it — by the same rights file (forwarding to the leader, visible at a follower), the row `platform/configstore-doors/<id>` with a fresh `seen_at`, the metrics row `configstore_doors` at the leader. A door whose `-id` is not the server of its leaf — a start refusal. The leaf of a door writes at the leader a foreign row of the family `platform/configstore-doors/` — 403, its own — 200 (N1.3 `door` «own»); the role forwarding header in a probe is a designation, the name is from the implementation description (judge-only: sc. 07, 26; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.3-R016).
- **Membership, restart, leader change, quorum.** A size outside `sizes` of N1.3 — a start refusal; `leave` of a stopped member, its `join` before `admit` — 403, `admit` is repeatable (code 0), after it `join` with the same address — 200, with another Raft address — 409, `leave` of an unknown member — 409 (N1.3 `leave`, `repeat`); a restarted member is a follower again. After a restart of a follower and of the whole group the versions are the same at all members, and a write with `cas` of that version passes (the log is not applied again). After a leader change a read at the remaining members sees the version of a write, a returned member too (the read is linearizable, P/01.1 N3). A write through a door and through a voter without a quorum — 503 `unavailable` after the effective `-leader-wait` interval: the door is not part of the quorum (judge-only: sc. 17; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.1-R062).
- **`import` into a group and `recover`.** `import` of a copy into a fresh group at the leader; a repeat of a completed one — a refusal (N1.3 `admin_ops`). The transferred rows keep the versions of the copy, and `cas` by them passes (P/01.3 N1.3 `import`, N3 «the copy is replayed into exactly those rows and versions»): an implementation that rewrites the transfer by ordinary `put` with new small versions fails here. That the new versions after the transfer are above `-index-base`, the scenario does not judge by numbers (the strings are compared only by `==`/`!=`) — by reading. With the majority lost, `recover` without `-isolated` and with `-upper` below the computed one — a refusal before any changes; with `-isolated` — the floor by the upper of the epoch rows, the rows and the epochs are kept (upper is from all epoch rows). The former members with old directories do not return (N3 step 0); new members join from empty directories (`-force` at a transitional parity); the floor is visible at a new follower (judge-only: sc. 18; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.3-R018, P/01.3-R020, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R022, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R022).
- **A door leaf on `-raft`**: the leaf of a door on the raft port of a member — `handshake: alert` (P/01.3 N1.6 `raft`) (judge-only: sc. 07; checks P/01.3-R009).
- **Forwarding, metrics and a cut raft port**: the leaf of a voter with the role forwarding header `admin` at the leader with a loaded rights file — 403 (P/01.2 N3); the `/metrics` rows of the leader and of a follower (the names of N1.3 `metrics`, the state in lowercase per ADR-0070); a proxy on the raft port of a member cuts incoming connections (the outgoing connections of the member go directly): after a write a read at the cut member — the new version or 503, not the earlier one, after `@mend` — the new one (the steps do not assume who the leader is) (judge-only: sc. 07, 17; checks P/01.2-R025, P/01.3-R006, P/01.3-R032, P/01.1-R062).
- **Door status, door rows, import and recover edges**: `/v1/status` of a door whole by N2: `Door`, `role` `door`, `term`, `commit`, `applied` — 0; the leaf of a door at the leader: its own row with `cas: ""`, with an extra element and its deletion — 403, its own row by the form — 200 (N1.3 `door`: only `put` without `cas` and `guard`, the single `seen_at`); a live door has written its row: `import` of a copy with `-index-base` below the versions of the copy — a refusal, no rows; with `-index-base` not below them — transferred, the version of the copy is kept (a door row does not cancel freshness); with the majority lost `recover -peers` without its own member, without an `api` address, with a repeat of a member — a refusal; a `-upper` above the computed one raises the floor; `import` of a copy with a future `generation_at` of the floor without `-force` — a refusal, nothing is transferred, with `-force` — transferred, the floor is raised (N1.3 `floor` `when`, «Daemon flags» `-force`) (judge-only: sc. 25–29; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.3-R007, P/01.3-R016, P/01.3-R020, P/01.3-R021).
- **A lost answer of a forwarded write (sc. 32–34)**: `@cut store@s1 answer` at the leader `s1`, then a write. The leader executes and commits it, its answer does not reach the caller. A door with `id` (sc. 32), a follower with `id` (sc. 33) and a door without `id` (sc. 34) answer 503 `ambiguous`, not `unavailable`: the write went to the leader without an answer. A door with `id` may retry at other voters; they forward to the leader through the same proxy, their answer is `ambiguous` too, so the outcome of the door stays `ambiguous` within its attempts. A commit through another member, after a change of the leader, does not change this outcome either: the proxy holds the answer, not the commit.
